verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Of David. How good and pleasant it is when God's people live together in unity!
It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down over the beard, down Aaron's beard, down to the collar of his robes.
It is like the dew of Mount Hermon falling on the hills of Zion. That is where the LORD gives his blessing, life that lasts forever.
